headline: BTCS Sells Majority of Ether Holdings to Repay $43.8 Million Aave Debt
summary: Blockchain firm BTCS liquidated more than half its Ether holdings to pay off $43.8 million in debt on DeFi platform Aave, after its liquidity unit generated $3.5 million in Q3 revenue.
why: BTCS is a publicly traded US company operating digital asset staking and decentralized finance operations.

impacts.name: BTCS
impacts.why: BTCS sold over half its Ether reserves to extinguish $43.8 million in Aave protocol debt.
